name: Listdom Ads Addon – Display Ads on Listing Pages
author: Webilia Inc.

sections.description:
The Listdom Ads Addon allows you to insert advertising content into your directory’s listing pages without any coding. Whether you want to monetize using Google AdSense, display affiliate banners, or insert promotional content, this addon lets you place global or per-listing ads directly inside your Listdom Single Listing pages.

After activating the addon, two ad placement options are available:

  • Global Ad: Enter your ad code, HTML, or shortcode in Listdom → Settings → Addons → Ads Addon. This content will be displayed on all listings by default.
  • Listing-Specific Ad: On each Add/Edit Listing screen (in both backend and frontend dashboard), you’ll see an ad input field that overrides the global ad for that particular listing.

The ads are displayed in a predefined section of the single listing layout, making them blend in cleanly with your design. You don’t need to edit any template files or write code — just paste your content, and it will appear where it should.

Key Features:

  • Display ads on listing detail pages to generate revenue
  • Use Google AdSense, affiliate banners, HTML code, or shortcodes
  • Global ads show across all listings with a single configuration
  • Per-listing ads override the global ad for custom sponsorships
  • Supports frontend dashboard and display option control (Listdom Pro Addon)
  • Seamlessly integrates with your site design

✅ Listdom Documentation – Learn how to configure this addon
✅ Official Site – More add-ons, themes, and support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New in the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the Listdom Ads Addon via the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure that the main Listdom plugin is installed and activated.
  4. To configure ads:
    • For global ads: Go to Listdom → Settings → Addons → Ads Addon, and paste your code or content into the Global Ad field.
    • For per-listing ads: Open any listing (in backend or frontend dashboard), and enter ad content in the provided ad field.
sections.faq:
Does this addon require Listdom?

Yes. You must have the Listdom plugin installed and active. The Ads Addon extends its functionality.

What types of ads are supported?

You can insert any ad format that works via HTML or shortcode — including Google AdSense, affiliate marketing banners, images, videos, or shortcodes from other plugins.

Can I show different ads on each listing?

Yes. The per-listing ad field allows you to override the global ad with unique content for that specific listing.

How do I manage where the ad appears?

The ad is shown in a predefined section of the Single Listing layout. You don’t need to configure placement manually — it will appear automatically according to your selected listing style.

How do I disable ads on certain listings or pages?

You have multiple visibility controls:
– Site-wide: Go to Listdom → Settings → Single Listing → Elements, and disable the Ads element entirely.
– Per listing: On the Add/Edit Listing page, navigate to Display Options and uncheck the Ads element (available in Listdom Pro Addon).
– Frontend dashboard: You can also hide the Ads field in the frontend submission form via Listdom → Settings → Frontend Submission → Restrictions → Modules.
